definition: רַ֫חַת noun [feminine] winnowing-shovel , or the like (√ unknown; Thes from רוח = ventilabrum , compare Nö ZMG xl (1886), 728 ; Wetzst in De Is (2), 709 from רחה = be soft, loose, friable , etc., compare Kö ii. 1, 177 ; Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew, Arabic is probably loan-word Nö l.c .); — וּבַמִּזְרֶה ׳ זֹרֶה בָר Isa 30:24 .
